name: Deben se Gecynde

facts.text: Level 80, 30,000 health. Every 45-70 seconds he calls thrawn ogre sceotan (archers) and thrawn abrecan mages; casts Major Conflagration and Major Ice Blast.
Se gecynde reads as 'the natural, the rightful, the kindred'; to verify.

story:
Deben calls himself the Rightful, and he means it: of all the ogres in Krondon he is the one who believes the hall was always meant to be theirs. He keeps the muster. Where Orylle rules and Beran counts, Deben summons, and when the hall is threatened his horn brings archers from the galleries and stormers from the mage-rooms, wave after wave, while he scorches and freezes the front rank himself. He is the reason a raid in Krondon never feels small for long.

The Rightful. Of all the ogres in Krondon, Deben is the one who believes. The others took the hall because it was there; Deben took it because it was theirs, and always had been, and he tells anyone who will listen that the thrawn ogres dug under the isles before the hall-folk came, and that the hall was built on their roof without their leave. Se gecynde, he calls himself, the natural, the rightful, the kin of the place.

The muster. He keeps the war-horn. Where Orylle rules, Beran counts and Morgus teaches, Deben summons, and when the hall is threatened his horn brings the sceotan, the archers, out of the galleries and the abrecan, the stormers, out of the mage rooms, wave after wave every minute or so. He casts great fire and great ice on the front rank himself while his waves come in. He argues with Beran over the siege pitch, which he wants for his muster and Beran wants for himself, and he has never won. He is the reason a raid in Krondon never feels small for long.
legend:
Deben keeps calling. Archers and mages come in waves every minute or so, and if you leave them up the next wave lands on top. Kill each wave as it comes, keep a party on him, and watch for both fire and ice from the old brute.

Count the waves out loud in raid chat; the raids that lost to Deben lost track of how many were up. Keep the healers away from the galleries, where the archers come in. A raid that keeps up with the waves will find Deben himself only a strong ogre with a temper. A raid that falls behind finds the whole muster of Krondon on its back within three minutes, and nobody walks out of that.

loremasterTopic.text: Deben se Gecynde, the Rightful. He believes Krondon was always the ogres' hall. He keeps the muster, and his horn calls archers and stormers in waves. Kill each wave as it comes.

bookPage: Deben told us, while his archers came out of the galleries, that the ogres had dug under these isles before the hall-folk ever laid a stone, and that the hall was built on his people's roof without their leave. I do not know if it is true. The ghosts of the hall did not deny it when I asked them. He called himself the Rightful, and he fought as a man fights for his own house, sounding his horn again and again, burning and freezing our front rank while his waves came in. I think he was the only ogre in Krondon who truly loved it.
